lines.beaver_en: Did you decide what to wear to Saturday's wedding?
lines.learner: 아니, 정장을 입을까 했는데 너무 더울까 봐.
lines.en: No, I thought about a suit, but I'm afraid it'll be too hot.
lines.roman: ani, jeongjangeul ibeulkka haenneunde neomu deoulkka bwa.

lines.beaver: 야외 결혼식이지? 그럼 반팔 셔츠는 어때?
lines.beaver_en: It's an outdoor wedding, right? How about a short-sleeved shirt?
lines.beaver_roman: yaoe gyeolhonsigiji? geureom banpal syeocheuneun eottae?
lines.learner: 반팔은 좀 가벼워 보일까 봐 걱정돼. 긴팔이 나을까?
lines.en: I'm worried short sleeves look too casual. Are long sleeves better?
lines.roman: banpareun jom gabyeowo boilkka bwa geokjeongdwae. ginpari naeulkka?

lines.beaver_en: A long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves is cool.
lines.learner: 좋아. 줄무늬 셔츠랑 꽃무늬 셔츠 중에 뭐가 나아?
lines.en: Okay. Which is better, a striped shirt or a floral one?
lines.roman: joa. julmuni syeocheurang kkonmuni syeocheu junge mwoga naa?

lines.beaver_en: It's spring, so floral would look bright and nice.
lines.learner: 그럼 꽃무늬로 할게. 내 스타일이랑도 잘 맞아.
lines.en: Then I'll go with floral. It fits my style too.
lines.roman: geureom kkonmuniro halge. nae seutairirangdo jal maja.

lines.beaver_en: What about outerwear? It'll be a bit chilly in the evening.
lines.learner: 감기 걸리지 않도록 얇은 코트를 가져갈게.
lines.en: I'll bring a thin coat so I don't catch a cold.
lines.roman: gamgi geolliji antorok eolbeun koteureul gajyeogalge.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Shoes? Sneakers aren't quite right.
lines.learner: 부츠는 어때? 비 올까 봐 걱정돼서.
lines.en: How about boots? I'm worried it might rain.
lines.roman: bucheuneun eottae? bi olkka bwa geokjeongdwaeseo.

lines.beaver: 부츠 좋다. 리본 넥타이도 해 볼래?
lines.beaver_en: Boots are good. Want to try a ribbon tie too?
lines.beaver_roman: bucheu jota. ribon nektaido hae bollae?
lines.learner: 리본은 좀 부끄러워. 그냥 넥타이 없이 갈래.
lines.en: A ribbon is a bit embarrassing. I'll just go without a tie.
lines.roman: riboneun jom bukkeureowo. geunyang nektai eopsi gallae.

lines.beaver: 그래. 그날 종일 서 있어야 하니까 편하게 입어.
lines.beaver_en: Okay. You'll stand all day, so dress comfortably.
lines.beaver_roman: geurae. geunal jongil seo isseoya hanikka pyeonhage ibeo.
lines.learner: 맞아. 근데 다음 날 등산도 가.
lines.en: Right. But I'm also going hiking the next day.
lines.roman: maja. geunde daeum nal deungsando ga.

lines.beaver: 바쁘다! 그럼 가방 하나에 다 챙겨.
lines.beaver_en: Busy! Then pack everything in one bag.
lines.beaver_roman: bappeuda! geureom gabang hanae da chaenggyeo.
lines.learner: 응, 잠옷도 잊지 않도록 지금 바로 쌀게.
lines.en: Yeah, I'll pack right now so I don't forget my pajamas.
lines.roman: eung, jamotdo itji antorok jigeum baro ssalge.

lines.beaver: 잘했어. 결혼식 사진 꼭 보내 줘!
lines.beaver_en: Good. Be sure to send me wedding photos!
lines.beaver_roman: jalhaesseo. gyeolhonsik sajin kkok bonae jwo!
lines.learner: 고마워! 네 덕분에 옷차림 고민이 다 끝났어.
lines.en: Thanks! Thanks to you, my outfit worries are all over.
lines.roman: gomawo! ne deokbune otcharim gomini da kkeunnasseo.
